claim: For file systems using Elastic throughput and mounted with amazon-efs-utils version 2.0 or later or the Amazon EFS CSI Driver, the maximum combined read and write throughput for a Linux NFSv4.1 client is 1,500 mebibytes per second (MiBps).
question: What is the maximum per-client combined throughput for an EFS file system with Elastic throughput?

qualifiers.condition: Elastic throughput; mounted with amazon-efs-utils 2.0 or later or the EFS CSI Driver

evidence.quote: Maximum combined read and write throughput is 1,500 mebibytes per second (MiBps) for file systems using Elastic throughput and mounted using version 2.0 or later of the Amazon EFS client (amazon-efs-utils version) or the Amazon EFS CSI Driver (aws-efs-csi-driver).

claim: A file system can have a maximum of 10,000 access points unless you request an increase. Since February 10, 2025 the maximum is 10,000; it was 1,000 before.
question: How many access points can one EFS file system have?

evidence.quote: A file system can have a maximum of 10,000 access points unless you request an increase.

| [Increased access point quota](#document-history) | The maximum number of access points a single file system can have has increased from 1,000 to 10,000.
